name: sendproof/core
description: Framework-neutral Sendproof protocol core for PHP: preview, observed send, capture and embedded workbench assets.

suggest.mongodb/mongodb: Guarded MongoDB client and Preview transactions (needs ext-mongodb)
suggest.predis/predis: Write guard for Predis Redis clients
suggest.elasticsearch/elasticsearch: Write guard for Elasticsearch 8 and 9 clients
suggest.opensearch-project/opensearch-php: Write guard for OpenSearch 2 clients (PSR-18 and legacy transports)
suggest.google/cloud-firestore: Write guard for Firestore clients (needs ext-grpc)
